name: project-room-desktop
description: Desktop workspace for product specifications, services, tests and project topology

scripts.test: node --test scripts/project-config.test.cjs scripts/spec-kit.test.cjs scripts/environment.test.cjs scripts/agent-chat.test.cjs scripts/mcp-explorer.test.cjs scripts/mcp-management.test.cjs scripts/api-explorer.test.cjs scripts/oauth.test.cjs scripts/test-explorer.test.cjs scripts/process-metrics.test.cjs scripts/platform-process.test.cjs scripts/data-viewer.test.cjs scripts/chat-markdown.test.cjs scripts/cli-explorer.test.cjs scripts/component-management.test.cjs scripts/build-identity.test.cjs scripts/updates.test.cjs scripts/security.test.cjs scripts/detached-service.test.cjs scripts/prerequisites.test.cjs
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:demo && node scripts/build-dictation.cjs && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:app: npm run build:demo && node scripts/build-dictation.cjs && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --publish never --config.mac.identity=null --config.mac.forceCodeSigning=false --config.mac.notarize=false --config.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist
scripts.package:win:unsigned: npm run build:demo && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --arm64 --publish never --config.win.forceCodeSigning=false
scripts.package:win:app: npm run build:demo && electron-builder --win dir --x64 --publish never --config.win.forceCodeSigning=false

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Project Room records speech only while you dictate into Product Chat.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Project Room transcribes speech on this Mac for Product Chat.
